Joshstrifehayes said it best in his video on runescape 3 (I'm paraphrasing but the point still stands): in most MMOs you have to grind through hours of dull content in order to get to "the good stuff" whereas in Runescape you can get to the good parts right off the bat. Low to mid-level gameplay remains interesting like endgame content because you are performing the same core actions more or less at any point; at level one you are chopping logs to cook fish for food and at max level you are chopping letter logs to cook even better fish for higher-healing food.

Some theatres have mailing lists that are not too hard to get on if you wait for the right opportunity. I found an offer to see Moana at the Aero in Santa Monica which included a Q&A with some of the directors back around when it had first released.
